subject: Next step: 75-min Deep Ops Lab — proposed windows & attendees

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.inference>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Next step: 75-min Deep Ops Lab — proposed windows & attendees

Hi Alice — great conversation earlier. Quick recap and proposed next step to keep momentum:

Recap (2 bullets):
- We heard that ClearWave wants predictable inference latency for batch and realtime paths, plus visibility into per-route cost.
- You asked to see: (1) an end-to-end serving demo for your 2-model pipeline, (2) KV cache behavior for multi-tenant inference, and (3) our rollout/fallback options for model upgrades.

Proposed next step: 75-minute "Deep Ops Lab" with our ML infra + model-serving engineers to run a short demo against a sample workload and align on rollout/runbook.

Suggested windows (all PT):
- Wed Aug 11 — 10:00–11:15
- Thu Aug 12 — 13:00–14:15
- Fri Aug 13 — 09:00–10:15

Please confirm which window works, and who from your side will join (we recommend: 1 infra/ops owner, 1 model owner, 1 product stakeholder). We will include our infra lead and the engineer who will run the demo.

Draft agenda attached (deep_ops_lab_agenda_v1.pdf) and a short mutual action plan (CW-mutual-action-plan.xlsx) — both attached. If you prefer, feel free to open the calendar poll: https://cal.poll/clearwave-tdx-75min

Next steps when you reply: I’ll send a calendar invite with dial-in, attendee list, and pre-reads.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

—
Mina Haddad
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Perfect — locking Wed Aug 11 10:00–11:15 PT. I’ll send the invite in the next 10 minutes.

Quick notes on your asks:
- We will add a 15-minute demo of fallback behavior to a quantized variant and show latency/cost tradeoffs in real time. Ben will run that section.
- On connectivity: Sara, we typically need two outbound IPs opened to allow staging connections and an S3-compatible endpoint for sample data. I’ll include the IPs and a short network checklist in the invite.

Pre-reads included in the calendar invite: the agenda (deep_ops_lab_agenda_v1.pdf) plus a short read on our quantization profiles. I’ll also attach the mutual action plan and the HubSpot link to this deal.

See you all on Wed.
